entities.name: Porphobilinogen deaminase
observations: The 325-residue query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry Q54P93 from Dictyostelium discoideum.
Catalyzes tetrapolymerization of four porphobilinogen molecules into hydroxymethylbilane (pre-uroporphyrinogen).
The reference annotation places the protein in the cytoplasm.
Sequence contains Porphobil_deam domain PF01379.26 at residues 11–224 and Porphobil_deamC domain PF03900.21 at residues 237–311.
The enzyme participates in heme/porphyrin biosynthesis, corresponding to step 2 of 4 from 5-aminolevulinate to coproporphyrinogen III.

entities.name: Heme biosynthesis
observations: Porphobilinogen deaminase catalyzes the second enzymatic step in the route from 5-aminolevulinate toward coproporphyrinogen III and heme-related porphyrins.

entities.name: Porphobilinogen polymerization
observations: Four porphobilinogen monopyrroles are assembled into the linear tetrapyrrole hydroxymethylbilane, also called pre-uroporphyrinogen.
